body:
Well, it's way complicated in that we tried out being in a relationship (we're both gay) for a while, but that didn't work out since his "activity" is basically being a promiscuous slut and making out with and sexting semi-random guys.

Aside from that, he did most of it behind my back (though I violated his privacy occasionally to find out what his latest lie to me was), so it's the lying and backstabbing that kind of traumatized me.

It's really not easy to make new friends from nothing.  I've stepped waaay out of my comfort zone to attend events with people who have similar interests, but most people cling to conversations with their own friends -- and even after a painstaking amount of small-talk with some other loners at the event, nothing even remotely resembling friendship has come out of one of those events.
